question: Will Jens Hauge assist in Bodø/Glimt vs Lille OSC on Nov 3, 2026 (regular + stoppage time only)?

model.prompt_context:

- "No assist": Wins if Jens Hauge is credited with zero assists in the same match within the same window and time scope, or if he does not appear in the match.
